title: Pruning LLMs Like a Physicist: Block Removal as an Ising Optimization Problem
summary: This work reframes LLM pruning as an Ising optimization problem, where removing entire transformer blocks is treated like finding low-energy spin configurations. By mapping block importance to pairwise interactions, the authors apply physics-inspired solvers to identify optimal block subsets for deletion, enabling structured compression without retraining. The approach bridges statistical physics and efficient model deployment.
